items.title: A.J. Brown: Not practicing Wednesday
items.text:

items.title: Romeo Doubs: Practice window opened Wednesday
items.text:
The Patriots designated Doubs (shoulder) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Listed as DNP on Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison will be listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's injury report, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: No intention to stay with Steelers
items.text:
Rodgers said Wednesday during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" that he has no plans to remain with the Steelers after the team announced Tuesday that Mason Rudolph would replace him as the starting quarterback for Week 12, ESPN.com reports. "At this point, I'm not going back to Pittsburgh," Rodgers said. "That ship has sailed."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Johnson: Preparing to start again
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Johnson is preparing to start Sunday's game versus the Commanders due to Carson Beck's back injury, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carson Beck: Won't practice Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Beck (back) won't practice Wednesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
